propositions: Backend-neutral core modules contain literal lazy-load keys to Jira-specific adapters (adf and comment_limits) that execute unconditionally for any configured backend, violating vendor separation
Jira-specific comment body formatting and limit enforcement must be routed through port abstraction layers (FieldSanitizer and InboundMapper) instead of direct lazy-key resolution
The outbound comment-diff path decodes ADF dicts to text and truncates; these operations must delegate to InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text and FieldSanitizer.fit_comment respectively

The inbound apply path normalizes rich-text bodies (adf_to_text for dicts, identity for strings) via a new InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text method, replacing the literal key load and preserving defense-in-depth against raw ADF in EDIT events
A sweep test must verify no package-root core module (except inbound_fields.py with documented exemption) contains the rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira literal string
